notes: This is a standalone source-audit review record, not a game_controls_workbook, native profile, game-binding file or Overlay import.
Call audit(workbook, document, review_record=record) through the source API after replacing all pins with current fingerprints.
Map, native-contract, source revisions and workbook fingerprint must all match. Historical evidence does not establish fresh physical acceptance.
The record is independently bounded to 1 MiB. Keeping review decisions outside a large workbook does not change its contents or importer.
Each button decision uses a current layer/context/button route_id, disposition, reason and evidence locators. Held-finger exclusions and hidden #19/#24 still receive decisions.
An eligible accessible unused position also needs comparison: action_ids, result retain_empty or new_shortcut_candidate, reason and evidence. Merely calling it spare does not close its review.
Each requirement records id, origin, expectation, status, acceptance, evidence_status and evidence. Deferred or unverified work remains open.
The audit never imports physical PASS or authorizes Save, Apply or Publish. This empty example intentionally reports missing pins, selection and decisions.
